why_it_matters: Discovery 0118 closed G-hs3-ii and G-hs3-iii inside the machine (T4OffM): the off-line M-wire is one cited convexity mass and the lifted wire sum p8_B + MwireOff is strictly below the endpoint floor on the strip band (margin ~16 orders). This discovery performs the splice 0118 predicted: the endpoint's G-hs3 face is no longer the analytic statement 'Qside <= BwireP + MrP at an off-pair' (which is exactly the off-line lift the body cannot produce at the on-line wire). It is now the LIFTED-wire statement 'Qside <= (off-line EM wall, n4 schedule) + (off-line lifted M-wire)', and both machine steps of that face are IN BODY at the endpoint: the wall side by t4wall_offline_le_bwires (discovery 0117) and the floor side by t4m_margin (discovery 0118). Consequence: the S3 leg AND the S4 strip leg of the stripfront endpoint above the frontier are proven in body from the machined face; what remains named on G-hs3 is the face itself over the actual zero set - whose content is the classical 1.6 convexity mass (the same bound the tree already cites on the line, transferred through the functional equation) plus the CITED [Z78]/[Z-H] zero-free records, not an analytic barrier in the tree. The endpoint's open height interval is still strictly above 3,000,175,332,800, and its named residual is now exactly: G-hs1 (S1 scale face), the window zero-exclusion face hWin, and the machined hs3 face (cited-mass content). No RH claim.
next: Two open faces remain above the frontier: G-hs1 (the S1 scale/lower-bound face - the measured-shadow track is S1Marg) and the window zero-exclusion face (the record-shadow face). The machined hs3 face is CITED-content: to close it one supplies, per off-pair, the off-line EM wall bound (pure T4OffD: cited [Z78]-class wall + n4 schedule) and the off-line kernel mass bound |K - (P_n - I_n)(s)| <= t4m_MwireOff (the 1.6 mass at the off-pair point - a classical convexity evaluation, checkable against a zeta record at the height). The remaining analytic work is therefore exactly G-hs1 and the window face. Also: t4m_Bmono allows moving the wall off the n4 schedule to any smaller admissible n, which is the slack a witness-level implementation would use.
